verdict.rationale: Wise directly documents a program for offering accounts without a financial license (wise-docs-5) backed by supporting account/currency/card/API features (wise-docs-1,3,4,6). However, community reports of sudden account-detail changes with zero notice and unexplained account freezes (wise-comm-2,3,5,6) raise significant reliability concerns for a developer building an embedded banking product on top of Wise.
